end.summary:
Observed bird features, including beaks and webbed feet.
Identified a hawk’s curved, hook-like beak.
Linked webbed feet to pushing water and swimming.
Linked a pointed beak to catching fish.
Teach-back was not passed; feature description was practised twice without unaided correct responses.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing beaks and feet and linking their shapes to feeding and movement. They explained that webbed feet help a duck push water backward to swim forward, and that a pointed beak can help catch fish. The main mix-up was describing the duck’s beak as both slightly flat and pointed; this was not clearly corrected by the end. At home, ask them to draw two birds and label one beak or foot feature with its use.
